newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady-firm - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady-firm - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers steady to firm, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs some 71.00-71.50. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs some 71.00.
On a carcass basis, steers and heifers firm.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs. 113.00 west 114.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs west 114.00.
Reported sales for Wed - 1,900 Week to Date - 10,400
